note: The two methods NSArray carries for GameplayKit. The corpus does not name them -- it attributes NSArray's members to Foundation -- but they are API this port carries, and a category on a class the release already has needs a row of its own.

entries.reason: a shuffle of an array is logic over the array and the source it is handed, and needs nothing of the device
entries.source: the host's own GameplayKit, measured by tests/backports/host/gameplaykit-core/measure.m
entries.effect: both methods hand the array to the source and return what the source answers, which is what the host does: -shuffledArrayWithRandomSource: sends -arrayByShufflingObjectsInArray: to the source it was given, and -shuffledArray is that over +[GKRandomSource sharedRandom]
